paired_time_sign: Reference minus candidate; positive means candidate faster.
work_columns: Proposed and applied requested work use their power requests and the actual block duration. Delivered wheel work is integrated by the physical model.
attribution_rule: A raw feasibility gain requires stable constrained raw and an infeasible penalty raw. A raw or guarded time gain requires positive gaps at both grids within every acceptance limit. A guard rescue requires stable guarded evaluation and infeasibility in the same training arm without the guard.
